slides.title: African parties summit ends in Addis Ababa
slides.body: Declaration adopted Nov 7, state media says.

slides.title: Hosted by Ethiopia
slides.body: Ethiopia's government and ruling Prosperity Party hosted the Nov 5-7 summit in Addis Ababa.

slides.title: What it says
slides.body: Declaration "rejects unconstitutional changes of government" and backs rule of law and pluralism. Single state-media source.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: The report gives no attendance figures or full text. No independent reaction reported.

slides.title: Peaceful dialogue and political rights for all.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
